facts: Elizabeth Holmes founded Theranos after discussing her ideas with Stanford chemical engineering professor Channing Robertson in 2003.
Theranos has raised more than $400 million from equity sales, valuing the private company at more than $9 billion.
The company operates a high-complexity laboratory certified by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services.
Theranos blood tests require only a few drops of blood collected via a finger stick into a tiny vial called a nanotainer.
Prices for Theranos tests are set to never exceed half the Medicare reimbursement rate for each procedure.
Walgreens committed in September to a gradual national rollout establishing Theranos collection centers in its drugstores.
